SEARCH

All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AbstractReportGenerator<D>
The abstract class of the Template Method pattern.
ActivityStats
Active coding time, idle time and editing figures for one session.
AnonymousIdProvider
Makes an anonymous student ID, such as student-1a2b3c4d, so no real name or student number is stored.
BackupObserver
A concrete observer that saves a JSON backup of the session at most once every two minutes, so data is not lost if BlueJ closes unexpectedly.
BackupStore
Writes, deletes and recovers the backup file telemetry-backup.json.
BaselineClassesCommand
Command that records the classes already in a project when it opens, so they are not reported as new.
ClassDeletedCommand
Command that records a class being deleted.
ClassRenamedCommand
Command that records a class being renamed.
ClassSnapshot
The state of one class at one moment: its name, whether it is compiled or has an error, and its method names.
ClassSnapshotReader
Reads a class's name, compile state and method names from BlueJ into a ClassSnapshot.
ClassStateCommand
Command that records a class's new state, so creations, modifications and new methods can be detected.
ClassTelemetryListener
Listens for BlueJ class events (state changes, renames and removals) and turns each one into a command.
ClassTracker
Remembers each class's methods, so a class creation or a new method is reported only once.
Clock
Gives the current time.
Command
The Command interface of the Command pattern.
CommandQueue
Somewhere commands can be submitted to be run later.
CompileStats
Compilation counts for one session.
CompileTelemetryListener
Listens for compilations the student starts and records their start, each error, and success or failure.
DetailKeys
The names used for the extra values (details) stored with each event, so every class spells them the same way.
EditBurst
A group of edits to one class that happened close together.
EditCoalescer
Groups edits that are less than 2 seconds apart into edit bursts.
EditCommand
Command that records one edit in a class editor.
EditDocumentListener
Listens to one class editor and records how many characters were inserted and deleted.
EditorAttacher
Attaches exactly one EditDocumentListener to each class editor, and remembers which classes already have one.
EndSessionCommand
Command that ends the session: it records the end, writes the final reports and deletes the backup.
ErrorCodeClassifier
Turns a compiler message into an error code, for example "cannot find symbol" into CANNOT_FIND_SYMBOL, so errors can be grouped by type.
ErrorFrequency
One compilation error code and how often it happened.
ErrorFrequencyComparator
Sorts error frequencies from most to least frequent, then by code name.
ErrorHandler
Reports errors from background work.
EventTimeComparator
Sorts events by their timestamp, earliest first.
EventType
Every kind of telemetry event the extension records.
ExportedFilesMessage
Shows a message listing the report files after a manual export.
ExportMenuAction
Runs when the student clicks Tools, then Export Telemetry Report.
ExportReportsCommand
Command that writes the reports in the middle of a session.
InvocationTelemetryListener
Listens for finished program runs (method calls and object creation from BlueJ) and records how each run ended.
JsonEvent
The shape of one event in the JSON file.
JsonMetadata
The shape of the metadata block in the JSON file.
JsonReportGenerator
A concrete class of the Template Method pattern that writes the session as a JSON file with Gson: a schema version, the metadata block and the event log in time order.
ListenerContext
Holds the objects every BlueJ listener needs, so each listener takes one parameter instead of four.
LogErrorHandler
Reports errors from background work by writing them to BlueJ's log, so a failure never crashes BlueJ.
LogReportsWritten
Logs the report file paths when the final reports are written at shutdown.
MessageDialog
An information dialog that tells the student where the exported reports were saved.
PackageTelemetryListener
Listens for BlueJ projects opening and closing.
PdfCanvas
A helper over PDFBox that draws the parts of the report (heading, sections, tables, bar charts, the pie chart and the footer) and keeps everything within the page limit.
PdfReportGenerator
A concrete class of the Template Method pattern that draws the one-page PDF report: a header, then active versus idle time, the frequency of compilation errors, and the class and method timeline, each as a table and a chart.
ProjectOpenedCommand
Command that records a project opening and remembers its folder, so the reports can be saved there.
RecordEventCommand
Command that records one ready-made event, such as a compile error or a program run.
ReportExporter
Runs every report generator and decides where the files go and what they are called.
ReportGenerator
Something that writes a report file for a session.
ReportsWrittenListener
Told which report files were written, after an export or at shutdown.
RunOutcome
How a program run ended.
RunStats
Program run counts for one session.
SessionStatistics
Every figure calculated for one session.
StatisticsCalculator
Works out every figure in the reports from the session's events: active and idle time, compile and run counts, error frequencies, typing speed and the class and method timeline.
StopCommand
Marker command that tells the worker thread to stop.
SystemClock
The real clock, using the computer's time.
TelemetryEvent
One telemetry event: its type, a millisecond timestamp, the class involved and a map of extra details.
TelemetryEventFactory
Creates every kind of telemetry event with the right type, timestamp and details.
TelemetryExtension
The entry point BlueJ loads.
TelemetryHub
The concrete subject of the Observer pattern.
TelemetryInvoker
The invoker of the Command pattern.
TelemetryMenuGenerator
Adds the Export Telemetry Report item to BlueJ's Tools menu.
TelemetryObserver
The observer interface of the Observer pattern.
TelemetryRecorder
Receives the work from the commands and publishes the resulting events to the hub.
TelemetryService
Creates every part of the extension and connects them.
TelemetrySession
One BlueJ session: its anonymous student ID, start and end times, the folder of the last project opened, and the event log.
TelemetrySubject
The subject interface of the Observer pattern.
TimelineEntry
One class created or method defined entry in the progression timeline.
Timestamps
Formats times for the JSON file, file names and the PDF.
TrackedClass
What the ClassTracker remembers about one class.
